name: Can't Get A Snapshot
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Tap the green curtains to reveal the cardboard box.
Drag the cardboard box to the girl.
Tap the locker to let the cat out.
Drag the cat to the photographer.
Wait until the photographer gets distracted.
Swipe the girl toward the open doorway.
Enter the locker room to complete the level.
